description.text: Root files for the first create, including LICENSE from the project license and a slim .gitignore. version.json is not a checkbox here; choose This repository on a first create to add the root file. Visual Studio requires at least one value; choose None when adding another library to the same repository.

Puts each .slnx next to that library's notes under src/sln/{name}/ so multiple libraries do not share one directory. Visual Studio also creates a root .slnx; close Visual Studio, open the src/sln solution, and delete the extra root .slnx.
Checked values write explicit C# and debug properties on the class library, tests, and benchmark. XML documentation is library-only. Uncheck one to write the alternative.

Default is This library (Properties/version.json) on every create. This repository writes root version.json on a first create; later libraries keep This repository and choose None for root items. Off keeps VersionPrefix in the library project.
Adds Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.PublicApiAnalyzers to this class library. The first build writes Properties/PublicAPI baseline files if they are missing. Test and benchmark projects are not affected.

Optional DocShell.html seed. NuGet package docs go under this library's NugetAssets/docs and pack with the nupkg. Repository docs go under docs/ at the repo root (first create only). Choose None when adding another library unless you only want package docs. Bootstrap and mini docs are a checkpoint task.
Default MIT. Standard licenses set PackageLicenseExpression and keep License.txt on disk. Custom packs License.txt as the NuGet license file. The LICENSE file at repository root copies this license.

name.text: Code style rules for library project

description.text: Single choice. Default is Strict: naming, XML docs, nullable, and unused usings fail the build. Default (style suggestions) is the same dump without those errors. Off writes no file. Test and benchmark projects are not affected.
SDK CA rules on the class library only. Default Recommended. Minimum is fewer warnings. All is almost every CA rule. Separate from code style Strict and from Public API analyzers.

Single choice. Default is Coverlet: dotnet test fails below 100% line, branch, and method coverage on the library. Edit Threshold in the test csproj if you want less. Coverlet and ReportGenerator also writes HTML/Markdown. None writes no extra test packages. ReportGenerator needs Coverlet output, so the two are not independent checkboxes.
